key_insight: This paper shows how to combine looping and mixture-of-experts (MoE) in a way that reuses parameters more effectively without simply repeating the same expert routing. The proposed Foil approach "flattens" experts and unties attention so a MoE model can be looped more efficiently.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the question of how to correctly loop a sparse MoE model. Standard looping works well for dense transformers, but MoE adds expert routing and compute sparsity, making naive repetition inefficient or suboptimal.
method: Introduce Foil, a looping strategy designed specifically for MoE models.
Flatten the expert structure so expert parameters can be reused more effectively across loops.
Untie the attention mechanism across loops to preserve flexibility while reusing computation.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this offers a new way to scale model performance using fixed parameter budgets more efficiently. It is especially relevant for training or deploying large sparse models where compute reuse and expert utilization are important.
visual_elements: Side-by-side diagram of a standard Looped Transformer versus a Looped MoE

Simple compute-vs-performance chart highlighting improved parameter usage
paper_title: How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention
paper_authors: Shouren Wang, Chuang Ma, Mohsen Hariri, Debargha Ganguly, Wang Yang
